headline: WNBA Semifinals Game 2: Liberty fight back to edge Dream 86-80 and level series
whyCareReason: New York answer with a resilient 86-80 road victory behind 26 points from Sabrina Ionescu, leveling the best-of-five series 1-1.
teaser: Liberty level series 1-1 with 86-80 win in Atlanta. Semifinal shifts to Brooklyn for Game 3.
story: The New York Liberty responded to Sunday's opening defeat with a clutch 86-80 road victory over the Atlanta Dream on Wednesday night at Gateway Center Arena. Sabrina Ionescu led all scorers with 26 points, including four three-pointers, while Breanna Stewart added 21 points and 12 rebounds. Atlanta got 22 points from Jordin Canada, but New York closed the game on an 11-4 run. The best-of-five semifinal series is now tied 1-1 and shifts to Barclays Center in Brooklyn for Game 3.
stakes: Series level 1-1 heading to Barclays Center in Brooklyn.
rivalryAngle: Defending finalist Liberty reclaim home-court advantage.
